name: io.github.czcz0009/carsensor-price-range-mcp
title: carsensor Price Range MCP Server for AI Agents
description: Get a used car's market-price range (min/max/median) by model and year from carsensor.net.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Your own Apify API token, formatted as 'Bearer <token>'. Get one at https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations. Required because this server bills each successful call via Apify Pay-Per-Event ($0.03/call) under your own Apify account — there is no shared/free token.
